$Comment: The sound a player hears each time the trick-or-treat line pays out, to that player alone. The
loot table Hallows_Eve_Trick_Or_Treat names this moment with its Cue, and a cue fires only when
the sweets beside it were actually paid. The library already shows a toast listing what the
line paid, so this moment adds no toast of its own; add a Toast group for a fixed line beside
it, or a Broadcast group to tell the whole server.
